baseline_models.mechanism: The recipients begin as a group left in the rear, but the future summons inclines them toward a collective that rises to an affair. The address therefore retains a route from exclusion into responsible movement.

activation_trace.role: Remaining at the rear supplies the recipients' initial exclusion and inertia.
A vocal call that inclines its hearer supplies the movement away from the rear.
Rising with resolve toward an affair makes the encountered people also an image of mobilized collectivity.

changed_reading.before: Those previously absent are only labeled and assigned another campaign.
changed_reading.after: Those fixed at the rear receive a future call that can remobilize them into responsible collective action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ تُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: The opponent is a resistant collective whose force is possessed, organized, and tightly strong. The reciprocal fighting is not left open-ended: handing over or entering peace remains a live terminating outcome.

activation_trace.role: Resistance and direct contest make the people an active opposing force rather than a passive object.
Taking charge of an affair contributes organized possession to the description of the force holders.
Compelling might supplies the opponent's capacity to resist.
Hard strength intensifies the opponent as a coherent difficult force.
Mutual fighting supplies the reciprocal confrontation.
Handing over and relinquishing supplies surrender as one endpoint.
Peace against warfare preserves cessation as a coexisting endpoint rather than collapsing it into destruction.

changed_reading.before: The clause issues an unbounded command to fight a powerful enemy.
changed_reading.after: It stages a bounded mutual contest against organized resistance, terminable by surrender or peace, with both terminal readings kept live.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَإِن تُطِيعُوا يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Obedience combines submission with a self made easy for the demand; divine giving then returns recompense as beneficent action. The condition tests willing pliancy, not mere bodily presence.

activation_trace.role: Compliance and yielding supply the explicit response to the summons.
The self becoming easy for an affair adds willing interior availability to outward compliance.
Giving supplies the return that follows the obedient response.
Recompense for work gives the return a responsive rather than arbitrary structure.
Beneficent action makes the recompense actively restorative, not merely pleasant in quality.

changed_reading.after: A willingly available self answers the call, and the answer opens a beneficent return for enacted obedience.

baseline_models.mechanism: The two conditions form opposite transfer channels. Obedience opens giving; refusal activates a root image of withholding or weaning that remains joined to explicit painful punishment.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the open channel in the obedient branch.
Withholding, prevention, and weaning supply a blocked channel in the refusal branch.
Punitive pain prevents the withholding image from replacing the verse's overt threat.
The description as pain-causing makes the blocked relation experientially severe.

changed_reading.before: Reward and punishment are unrelated positive and negative outcomes.
changed_reading.after: The condition routes relation itself: obedience receives a good transfer, while renewed withdrawal is met by painful prevention and deprivation as well as punishment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The repeated turning root, the comparison, and the temporal prior make refusal a reenacted trajectory. Turning away reverses proximity, and its repetition becomes more than a single missed action.

activation_trace.role: Turning the back and withdrawing supplies the overt act in both present condition and recalled past.
One thing following another without interruption turns the duplicated root into a recurrent behavioral sequence.
Nearness without a gap supplies the relation that the act of turning away abandons.
Temporal precedence fixes the current choice against an earlier occurrence.
Punitive pain marks the consequence of consolidating the repeated trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The warning concerns one possible future refusal.
changed_reading.after: The warning concerns recurrence: another turn would convert an earlier withdrawal into a repeated relational direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's opening image makes the difficult future summons function as a threshold. A group held at the rear can pass through that threshold by rising into the demanded affair; victory remains a coexisting sense of the opening.

activation_trace.role: An obstruction opening into a widened entrance supplies the threshold image for renewed participation.
Being held in the rear supplies the closed starting position.
The summons inclines the excluded group toward the threshold.
Rising to an affair supplies the act by which re-entry becomes concrete.

structural_cues: 48:1 places opening at the head of the same packet whose focus gives the rear group a future summons.
The focus conditional leaves the threshold open to obedience while preserving refusal as a real alternative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, rear-position, summons, and rising; I supply the arrow that the hard assignment is a gate of re-entry. Alternatively, the opening may orient the surah globally without naming a personal restoration process.

changed_reading.before: The later summons is simply another obligation imposed on excluded people.
changed_reading.after: The summons is also an opening through which rear-position can become renewed participation, although entry is neither automatic nor easy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge sequence frames obedience as a bond that can be completed or unraveled, with recompense returning to the completer. The focus call can therefore be read as an opportunity to enact repaired allegiance after prior withdrawal, not merely to satisfy an isolated order.

activation_trace.role: A pledge of obedience supplies the binding social form against which the focus response is measured.
Undoing a firmly made covenant supplies the failure mode parallel to renewed turning away.
Completion without deficiency supplies the positive covenantal response.
A preserved compact gives obedience durable relational content.
Recompense returning to its worker links enacted fidelity to a responsive return.
Obedience supplies the focus act that can complete rather than unravel allegiance.
Withdrawal supplies the focus failure that resembles covenantal unbinding.
Recompense answers the completed response rather than functioning as an arbitrary prize.

structural_cues: 48:10 pairs pledge completion with future recompense before 48:16 repeats obedience and recompense.
48:18 supplies an enacted pledge whose inward state is known and whose response receives a return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pledge, unbinding, completion, covenant, return, obedience, and withdrawal; I infer that the focus summons can serve as re-binding. The live alternative is that pledged believers only contrast with the rear group, without the latter being offered covenant repair.

changed_reading.before: 48:16 offers reward for compliance with a standalone command.
changed_reading.after: 48:16 offers an enacted chance to rebind allegiance: completion receives a returning recompense, while another withdrawal confirms unbinding.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated utterance is separated from heart and intended action, then an attempted substitution of divine speech is exposed. The focus chain of saying, being called, and obeying acts as a speech-to-body assay: the answer must travel beyond the tongue into action without rewriting the demand.

activation_trace.role: Repeated voiced saying supplies the outer speech layer that the focus command answers.
The tongue as speech organ localizes the stated excuse at the bodily instrument of utterance.
The heart supplies the interior site from which tongue-speech is explicitly separated.
Intended action supplies the observable layer against which speech is tested.
Putting one thing in another's place supplies the attempted rewriting of the demand.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies what the attempted substitution would alter.
The focus begins with voiced counter-speech addressed to the earlier speakers.
The future call relays speech into a demand for movement.
Obedience is the action that verifies whether the relay crossed from tongue into conduct.

structural_cues: 48:11 repeats saying around an explicit tongue-heart mismatch and ends with knowledge of action.
48:15 places attempted speech-substitution immediately before 48:16's fixed command and conditional response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer speech, interior heart, action, substitution, and the focus relay; I infer that the relay functions diagnostically. Alternatively, the neighboring speech may expose inconsistency without making the summons itself an assay.

changed_reading.before: The opening command merely communicates information about a future call.
changed_reading.after: The command initiates a performative test: voiced claims must become embodied obedience without substituting a more convenient message.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rear group first asks to follow where gains can be seized; the next ayah redirects them toward severe resistance and makes good recompense conditional on obedience. Later hastened gains remain real, but they no longer define the test. The sequence calibrates allegiance away from immediate acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Acquiring a benefit supplies the attractive destination the rear group asks to join.
Taking possession makes the requested following materially acquisitive.
Following behind supplies the movement requested when benefit is visible.
Later benefit confirms that material gain remains present but is sequenced beyond the focus test.
Hastening one gain distinguishes immediate return from the harder future summons.
Compelling might replaces easy acquisition with genuine resistance.
Hard strength raises the cost of the requested participation.
Obedience, rather than acquisition, becomes the decisive condition.
Recompense remains a return for action without being reducible to the immediately seized gains.

structural_cues: 48:15's request to follow for takeable gains is immediately answered by 48:16's call toward severe resistance.
48:20 later distinguishes many gains from one return that has been hastened.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisitive following, immediate taking, severe resistance, conditional recompense, and later hastening; I infer a motive-calibration sequence. The live alternative is that the focus expedition could itself yield material gain, but gain still does not control the condition's wording.

changed_reading.before: The focus promises another desirable return for joining another campaign.
changed_reading.after: The focus deliberately tests whether the group will answer when resistance, rather than visible spoils, defines the immediate horizon; good recompense is not a synonym for loot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah removes constriction or blame from concrete embodied incapacity and then repeats obedience, turning, and painful punishment. This bounds the focus threat: culpability attaches to agentive withdrawal by one able to answer, not to inability as such.

activation_trace.role: Repeated removal of constriction supplies the exemption frame around limited capacity.
Loss of sight supplies one concrete inability excluded from blame.
Impaired gait supplies a second bodily limit on movement.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply a third incapacity rather than a chosen refusal.
Capacity and ability expose a latent prerequisite within the focus condition.
Turning away supplies a directional choice distinct from embodied inability.
Punishment attaches to the chosen withdrawal once inability has been structurally excluded.

structural_cues: 48:17 is adjacent to the focus and repeats its obedience-versus-turning consequence after three exemptions.
The exemption list precedes, rather than interrupts, the repeated conditional.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily limits, removed constriction, capability, withdrawal, and repeated consequences; I infer that ability bounds liability. Alternatively, 48:17 could be a separate legal qualification, but even that reading constrains how broadly 48:16's threat can be applied.

changed_reading.before: Anyone who does not join falls under the focus threat.
changed_reading.after: The threat targets volitional turning by an able addressee; inability is explicitly separated from refusal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context twice presents force as actively withheld, including reciprocal hands after advantage, and explains non-attack through the danger of crushing unknown intermingled people until separation is possible. The focus combat is therefore real but governed by restraint, discrimination, and a peace or surrender endpoint.

activation_trace.role: Holding back hands supplies an active form of protection within a martial horizon.
Reciprocal prevention after advantage shows restraint operating on both sides rather than only through weakness.
Crushing pressure supplies the unintended harm that makes indiscriminate advance unacceptable.
Separation and distinction supply the counterfactual condition under which punitive force could proceed.
Mutual fighting keeps actual combat inside the model instead of dissolving it into metaphor.
Peace supplies a non-destructive terminal state for the confrontation.
Handing over supplies surrender as a coexisting terminal state.

structural_cues: 48:24 restrains both sets of hands after one side has gained advantage.
48:25 makes population intermixture and possible separation causally relevant to whether punishment proceeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies combat, restraint, crushing risk, distinction, peace, and surrender; I infer that these episodes qualify the ethics and endpoint of the focus confrontation. The alternative is that the restraint applies only to its local episode, while 48:16 remains less specifically bounded.

changed_reading.before: Severe resistance makes fighting the overriding directive until the opponent is defeated.
changed_reading.after: Fighting remains possible, but it is subordinated to controlled, discriminating force and can be stopped by restraint, surrender, or peace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same turning root later places the opponents' backs in retreat and removes protective nearness from them. This creates a reversible battle geometry: the focus addressees may turn away from the call, while the opposing side may turn away in defeat; protective alignment decides which withdrawal leaves one exposed.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the opponents' retreat and mirrors the focus addressees' possible withdrawal.
Protective alliance supplies the relation absent from the retreating side.
Presenting the back and withdrawing makes the spatial reversal explicit.
The focus warning supplies the addressees' possible retreat from alignment.
The rear position supplies the spatial vulnerability from which the addressees are being recalled.

structural_cues: 48:16 and 48:22 distribute turning across opposite sides of a possible confrontation.
48:22 joins retreat to the absence of both protective relation and aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored turning, backs, rear-position, and absent protection; I infer a reversible relational geometry. Alternatively, the root repetition may simply describe two unrelated withdrawals, but the shared martial window keeps the mirror active.

changed_reading.before: Turning away in the focus means only refusing to march.
changed_reading.after: Turning away chooses an exposed side of the same geometry in which retreat without protective alignment becomes defeat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus comparison with a prior turning is activated by a later image of a continuously followed path that has passed through earlier time and is not substituted. Another refusal would place the addressees on a recurrent course, not merely repeat a datum from memory.

activation_trace.role: A running, followed path supplies the durable course into which repeated conduct can settle.
Time and earlier generations passing supplies the historical depth of the course.
Replacement, under negation, supplies the course's resistance to being exchanged for another.
Uninterrupted succession makes the two turnings capable of forming a repeated course.
The earlier time anchors the present choice to a precedent.

structural_cues: 48:16 explicitly compares a possible turn with an earlier turn.
48:23 joins prior passage, repeated path, and non-substitution in one compact sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior repetition and an invariant followed path; I infer that renewed refusal enters that path as a pattern. Alternatively, 48:23 may describe a broader historical regularity without making the addressees' psychology habitual.

changed_reading.before: The past refusal is evidence cited against the addressees.
changed_reading.after: The past refusal is a path-dependency warning: repeating it makes their direction participate in a durable recurrent pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts heated pride with arrested motion and a protective word made binding, then later directs severity relationally rather than absolutely. Severe might in the focus is therefore not a license to imitate heat; the demanded strength is composed, attached to restraint, and directed.

activation_trace.role: Heated pride and anger supply the uncontrolled force against which disciplined severity is distinguished.
The cessation of agitation supplies composure under pressure.
Binding and attaching a norm supplies disciplined constraint rather than free heat.
Placing the self within protection gives the attached norm a guarding function.
Strong hardness is relationally directed in a syntax that balances it with a different internal relation.
Compelling might supplies the force that must be met without copying uncontrolled heat.
Severe strength is retained but qualified as composed and directed.
Obedience aligns the addressees' strength with the attached norm rather than with reactive pride.

structural_cues: 48:26 opposes two internal states under one pressure: heated pride and imparted stillness.
48:29 balances outward severity with a different internal relation, preventing severity from becoming a total character description.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat, stillness, binding, protection, and relationally directed severity; I infer these are normative controls on how the focus force is met. Alternatively, the contrast may characterize separate groups without prescribing the addressees' future conduct.

changed_reading.before: Answering a severe people requires matching their intensity with greater intensity.
changed_reading.after: Answering them requires controlled strength: force held under composure, protection, and binding obligation rather than tribal heat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final plant chain moves from a peripheral shoot through mutual support and thickening to stable upright bearing. It activates a formation reading of the focus: those left at the rear are not only deployed against another people; the summons tests whether a peripheral group can become load-bearing within a people that stands.

activation_trace.role: Cultivated growth supplies the process frame in which collective formation unfolds over time.
A shoot emerging around the original plant supplies a peripheral member that can still belong to the organism.
Plant parts strengthening one another supplies reintegration through support rather than mere addition.
A body thickening after thinness supplies acquired collective resilience.
Rising and settling upright supplies stable achieved posture.
The load-bearing stalk or leg supplies the support on which the formed body stands.
The rear group supplies a human analogue to the peripheral starting position.
Standing upright anchors the botanical formation back in the focus word for a people.
Strength supplies the quality acquired through support and thickening.

structural_cues: 48:29 presents one continuous botanical sequence: emergence, support, thickening, upright stability, and bearing.
The focus juxtaposes a rear-positioned group, a people, and severe strength, giving the plant sequence multiple lexical attachment points.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a peripheral shoot becoming mutually supported and upright, plus the focus rear-position, people, and strength; I infer a possible trajectory of reintegration. The live alternative is that the plant image describes only an already faithful collective, making its application to the rear group aspirational rather than identificatory.

changed_reading.before: The call only deploys an unreliable group against an external collective.
changed_reading.after: The call also tests collective formation: can a peripheral group become a supporting, strengthened part of a people able to stand?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant د ع ع target beneath د ع و. It remains anchored in the passive future summons and the recipients' rear-position, where a forceful displacement produces a changed reading. Downstream prose should call it a split-root pressure image, not a morphological gloss of تُدْعَوْنَ.

activation_trace.role: A hard push gives the summons latent coercive pressure beyond an ordinary invitation.
The stationary rear group supplies what must be displaced by the summons.

changed_reading.before: The future call is a neutral invitation that can simply be accepted or declined.
changed_reading.after: The call carries mobilizing pressure that pushes a rear-positioned group out of settled inertia, while response remains morally testable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق ل ل target under focus ق و ل. It remains anchored in the opening speech command and gains coherence from rear-position and rising to an affair. Downstream prose should present a lifting resonance in the utterance, never replace the ordinary sense of 'say' with 'lift.'

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and setting out make the commanded utterance resonate as speech that lifts into movement.
The rear-position supplies the low or inert state from which the address lifts.
Rising with resolve supplies the movement that the lifting speech seeks to produce.

changed_reading.before: The initial imperative only transmits a proposition.
changed_reading.after: The utterance itself carries a faint lifting function: it seeks to raise those at the rear into resolved movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the repair of a fracture set with residual crookedness is a secondary branch of أجر, not its ordinary recompense sense. It remains anchored in أَجْرًا حَسَنًا and the expressly repeated prior withdrawal, which supplies a damaged relation needing repair. Downstream prose should say the reward carries a repair image and preserve the possibility that healing does not erase prior deformation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَجْرًا حَسَنًا after obedience and before recalled withdrawal

activation_trace.role: Setting a broken limb, even with residual crookedness, supplies repair as a latent shape of recompense.
Beneficent action qualifies the repair as an active good done to the damaged relation.
Repeated withdrawal supplies the relational break that obedience may begin to mend.

changed_reading.before: The good reward is payment added after compliance.
changed_reading.after: The good reward may also figure the repair of an allegiance fractured by prior withdrawal, with the history of crookedness still legible after mending.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries non-primary ق ت ل branches of taming hardness and reducing a drink's strength into a clause that plainly includes mutual fighting. It remains anchored by the sequence severe strength, fighting, then submission or peace, which gives the softening mechanism a visible endpoint. Downstream prose must retain literal combat and qualify tempering as a material analogy, not an alternative lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: Taming until hardness becomes pliant supplies confrontation as a pressure that reduces unyielding resistance.
Breaking a drink's strength with water supplies a material analogy for tempering excessive intensity.
Hard strength supplies the resistant quality to be tempered.
Peace supplies the softened terminal relation.
Handing over supplies surrender as a coexisting concrete endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Combat is only the destruction of a severely strong opponent.
changed_reading.after: Without ceasing to be combat, confrontation can also be imagined as tempering unyielding force until it relinquishes resistance or enters peace.

strongest_changes: The future summons became a difficult gate of possible re-entry and covenantal rebinding for a group fixed at the rear.
The adjacency of desired spoils and severe resistance made obedience an anti-opportunist calibration rather than a route to immediate acquisition.
The combat clause remained literal while becoming bounded by surrender, peace, reciprocal restraint, and discrimination among intermingled people.
The adjacent exemptions sharply limited liability to able, volitional turning rather than inability.
Later heat, stillness, and plant growth activated composed strength and an exploratory collective-formation reading.
summary.what_was_special: Several readings stayed live at once: summons as invitation, pressure, and lifting speech; reward as recompense and relational repair; punishment as pain and deprivation; combat as mutual fighting and a contained tempering process. The packet's repeated turning, speech, restraint, and growth images changed the focus from a flat campaign notice into a test of motive, capacity, allegiance, controlled force, and possible reintegration.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not identify the future people historically, so the trace keeps their function as organized severe resistance without naming them.
The plant sequence may describe only an already faithful collective; applying it to the rear group is an aspirational trajectory, not an identification.
The non-dominant ق ل ل and د ع ع targets and the secondary repair and tempering branches should remain activations, not ordinary lexical substitutions.
Peace and handing-over coexist at يُسْلِمُونَ; the packet does not require choosing one endpoint over the other.
